init: imagenet_backbone_fresh (NOT warm-started from v8/v9/v10); recipe read verbatim from the v10 checkpoint config
sampler: per-location WeightedRandomSampler(w_class[sqrt] x w_group[1/group] x w_source[beta])
selection: max eval not-bad AP (rank by sigma(logit0)); patience==epochs (full schedule)
recipe_vs_v7: IDENTICAL recipe read from v7 config; only delta = 1..4 head (3 cutpoints)
recipe_vs_v8: IDENTICAL — every hyperparameter is v8's own config value. The ONLY change is the corpus underneath: the same 7,117 locations re-rendered at the raised iteration cap.
recipe_vs_v9: IDENTICAL — every hyperparameter is v9's own config value, which was itself asserted identical to v8's. The ONLY change is the population: 1,267 maneuver-view locations appended.
corpus_note: 11,303 labeled locations (v10: 8,382) — a FRESH build, not an append: protocol §1's frozen prefix and a re-randomized split cannot both hold, and the split rule is what v11 changes. Comparability is carried by the instruments, reproduced location-for-location (data/v11/build_record.json).
selection_population: census + floor (670) — v8/v9/v10-COMPARABLE, frozen on purpose. The uniform-90, the q4-uniform-290 and the 1,810-row holdout are held out of training AND of the checkpoint pick; the objective is a controlled variable (prereg_v10.json amendment 1).
recipe_vs_v10: IDENTICAL — every hyperparameter is v10's own config value, itself asserted identical to v9's and v8's. What changes is the corpus, the split rule and the augmentation recipe.
split_rule: forced-eval score-unconditioned instruments (1,050) + a stratified random holdout (1,810) drawn over leakage-closure split groups; 8,443 train. seed 20260808.
aug_recipe: v11-independent-32: 32 tiles per location, each drawing its own palette (68-name pool), geometry, AA level and JPEG quality (q60..95). Supersedes v8b's 4x3x2 product.
